caption: The drawing shows a rectangular panel positioned horizontally in the center of the image, depicting a carved relief design. The relief is colored in shades of light to medium brown, resembling wood. Within the rectangular panel, there are symmetrical natural motifs, including four sets of leaves with rounded edges and clusters of berry-like or acorn-like shapes arranged in arches above and in between the leaves. The overall pattern repeats, creating a rhythmic design enclosed in a rectangular frame with a beveled edge. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or embellishments. There is a small, faint inscription in the lower right corner.
title: Carved Furniture Detail
